The '''Mark 16 Enzymer''' was manufactured by [[BioTech Industries/Legends|BioTech Industries]]. Like other [[enzymer]]s, the Mark 16 was capable of identifying biological residue and producing a counter-agent to known [[Bacteria/Legends|bacteria]] and viruses. [[Numbers (Bith)|Numbers]], the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] who ran the [[Irrational Number]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] at [[Jugsmuk Station]] on [[Gamorr/Legends|Gamorr]], maintained a Mark 16 on the premises with a [[Galactic Registry|Registry]] program that was only a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] out of date.<ref name="MS" />
